rule_hypotheses.rule: 2022-era (GDAA, treaty T00001) claims were paid exactly the Max Benefit regardless of documentation; Max Benefit equals the waived deposit amount on the SD-waiver addendum. Claims 10 and 13 had no itemization at all and were still paid in full.
Approved Benefit = PM's final outstanding balance (ledger ending balance / move-out statement total, net of credits) minus excluded categories, capped at Max Benefit.
Credits on the ledger (prepaid rent returned to owner, carpet-cleaning receipt credit) are subtracted before payout - adjuster pays net balance, not gross charges.
Excluded: garage rent, renters insurance / RBP, SD protection / SDRP premiums, pet-related carpet/extra cleaning, unspecified non-refundable flat fees ('per lease' carpet fee).

Pest control (roaches, bedbugs) WAS paid in 2024 claims when it is remediation of a tenant-caused infestation at move-out; the 'pest control excluded' note may apply only to routine/pet flea treatments.

Rent-based cap (monthly rent rounded up to next $500) is NOT consistently applied: approved exceeded it in 2024 claims 637 (rent 705 -> 1000 cap, paid 1375) and 843 (1720 -> 2000, paid 2740.90), and in 2022 claims 7/10. Where it coincides with Max Benefit (96, 699) it cannot be distinguished.
When covered unpaid in-term rent alone exceeds Max Benefit, payout = Max Benefit (exclusions of late/NSF/legal/premium fees become irrelevant).

Adjusters do not add charges the PM did not bill: early move-outs with no lease-break fee/future rent on the statement (507, 637) are paid only on billed damages/rent; holdover days not billed (843) are not added.
Collections fields (Agreed Tenant Settlement, Collected Amount) are independent of Approved Benefit (they are recovery from tenant after payout).

Covered damage categories seen paid: cleaning, carpet cleaning (non-pet), trash/haul-off, blinds, painting/drywall, repairs, flooring, make-ready, landscaping, keys/fobs, in-term rent (incl. current month rent at move-out).

extraction_lessons: Many key docs are scans with no text layer (TXR-2216 itemization inside a 40-page closeout PDF, SDRP move-out forms, Perry Reid ledgers, StarPointe ledgers, Blue Fox statement of accounting) - always check per-page text length and render pages with 0 chars.

Composite PDFs: one 'closeout' file may contain cover letter + itemization + make-ready checklist + vendor estimate/invoices + 30 pages of zInspector photos; zInspector photo reports contain no dollar amounts and can be skipped.
Some PDFs have garbled cid-font text layers (claim 13) - text cache looks non-empty but is useless; detect '(cid:' and render visually.

Propertyware ledgers are reverse-chronological running balances; end-of-tenancy 'Charge Adjustment' rows appear in the Payments column and reverse future rent/late fees - use the 'Balance as of' header / top balance as final.

Perry Reid (IA/NE) packets: 'Move Out Statement' (ledger extract) + 'SDI' form with 'Current Ledger Balance' (A) + maintenance charges (B); the SDI total = statement total. Move-out letter balance may differ from SDI (claim 776: 315 vs 465) - adjuster used the letter/ledger balance.
Files named 'SDI' are sometimes the SD-waiver addendum (claim 507), not an itemization.
New Heights 'SDRP Move-Out Form' lists deductions, total, SDRP band level and amount exceeding band - band level = Max Benefit.
Waived-deposit amount on the addendum does not always equal sheet Max Benefit (507: 1695 vs 2000; 637/776: 1200 vs 1500); trust the sheet Max Benefit.
StarPointe tenant has two ledgers (PW old system, RV new system from 12/2023); the RV ledger carries the final move-out charges and credits.
Vendor estimates may include owner-responsibility items (claim 7 estimate had $750 owner paint) that are not charged to tenant; use the itemization/statement figures, not raw vendor totals.
Folders may contain irrelevant documents (PM ACH direct-deposit authorization with voided check, court order of possession, generic resident policies).
